data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, my top recommendation is **1Password**\.

It strikes the best balance between security, ease of use, team administration, and sharing credentials securely.

For a small business, I would prioritize\:

- **Shared vaults\:** Share passwords without sending them through email or Slack.
- **Access controls\:** Give employees access only to the credentials they need.
- **Easy onboarding/offboarding\:** Add and remove team members without disrupting everyone else.
- **MFA support\:** Protect accounts with multifactor authentication.
- **Auditability\:** See who has access to shared credentials.

## My shortlist

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall experience)

- Excellent shared vaults and granular permissions.
- Strong administration and employee onboarding/offboarding.
- Canadian company, with Canadian data hosting available.
- Particularly good for non-technical teams.

Website: [1Password Business](https://1password.com/business/)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source core.
- Shared collections and team management.
- Audit logs and directory synchronization.
- Good choice for technically comfortable teams.

Teams pricing reported at approximately US\$4/user/month annually.

Website: [Bitwarden Business](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

(Best for administration)

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared folders and delegated administration.
- Useful for organizations with more formal security requirements.

Website: [Keeper Business](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Shared vaults and team collaboration.
- Worth considering if privacy is a major priority.

Website: [Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/pass/business)

Recent comparisons generally put Bitwarden ahead on price and 1Password ahead on usability and administration. ## What I'd choose

| Your situation | Recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| 3–10 employees | 1Password |
| Budget-conscious team | Bitwarden |
| Non-technical employees | 1Password |
| Technical/IT-heavy team | Bitwarden |
| Canadian data residency matters | 1Password |


## One important consideration for a Canadian business

1Password offers a Canadian data region and CAD billing. Its Teams Starter Pack is reported at **C\$29.95/month for up to 10 members**, billed annually. That's a compelling starting point if you don't need advanced enterprise controls.
